title: A project-bound note fails with database is locked during concurrent writes
outcome: Ordinary note writes handle concurrent SQLite writer admission without dropping the note or returning an unclassified database-is-locked failure; recording and uncertain-result semantics remain correct.
acceptance: A deterministic two-connection regression exercises a project-bound note while another connection holds the SQLite write transaction beyond the old busy timeout; once the contender commits, the admitted note is recorded exactly once without the generic database-is-locked refusal, with focus and holder/non-holder semantics preserved

The busy writer admission behavior is diagnosed on current source and corrected through a supported bounded mechanism; it does not blindly retry an uncertain commit, alter durable records or weaken mutation authority, and genuine resource-unavailability still returns explicit diagnostic evidence

completion.summary: Project-bound note writes share one lazy 10-second native SQLite writer admission window, preserving authority, focus, ordinary timeout settings and existing idempotent recovery. Busy/locked acquisition refusals provide typed timing/code/certainty diagnostics without retrying transaction bodies, commits or whole words.
